purpose: Source-backed TikTok hook and slide-text pattern bank for Coachi slideshow generation. Use this to keep slide 1 hooks and slides 1-6 simple, TikTok-native, and less AI-written.

source_policy.use: Use structure, pacing, vocabulary shape, and simplicity from proven TikTok search results.
source_policy.do_not_use: Do not copy creator-specific wording, exact full captions, faces, branding, watermarks, or slide designs.
source_policy.public_copy_rule: Generated Coachi copy must be adapted and Coachi-native, not pasted from a creator.
source_policy.preferred_text_length: Prefer 6-12 words for hook slides when that preserves the question, contradiction, number, or felt runner problem; payoff slides should usually stay 3-10 words. Never shorten a proven TikTok mechanic into a generic label.
source_policy.complexity_rule: No abstract coaching language on slides 1-6. Prefer concrete runner words: run, easy, slow, watch, pace, breath, walk, week, effort.

hook_rotation_policy.batch_rule: In a multi-post slideshow batch, maximize rotation across format_id, source_family_id, and problem_type before allowing any repeat.
hook_rotation_policy.selection_rule: Choose the most diverse viable batch first: fresh format, fresh hook family, and fresh problem type outrank small score differences between otherwise production-safe hooks.
hook_rotation_policy.fallback_rule: A repeated format, hook family, or problem type can be used only when the pool cannot fill the requested count otherwise, and the fallback must be marked in content_rotation.
hook_rotation_policy.main_account_guardrail: Do not let easy-run talk dominate consecutive main-account uploads. Rotate across first-mile, recovery, Zone 2, heart-rate, watch-checking, comparison, and workout-control families before repeating adjacent easy-run language.
